description.en: Agent control for the Browser panel DSH ships in the right Sidebar: numbered refs from a snapshot, click/type/press/select/scroll, a screenshot returned as an image, query-scoped reads and change diffs, batch steps and multi-tab focus/close.
description.zh: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照编号 refs、点击/输入/按键/选择/滚动、截图返回图像，按问题检索阅读与变化对比，批量步骤与多标签切换/关闭。
